teaches: A poison is the same four fields as a disease under a different sub-type — the schema does not branch.
`poison` is the second of the two Endurance-resisted sub-types, so the sheet offers the check here as it does on a disease.
A creature's `Poison` trait names a difficulty, a damage and an interval; this Item is where those become a document.
demo.trap: The sub-type is the whole of the difference. Change `poison` to `wound` on this document and the Endurance check silently stops being offered, because `MGT2.EnduranceResisted` lists only `disease` and `poison`.

system.description: What a marsh runner leaves in a bite. Slow, and it wants attention within the hour.
system.effect: The victim is stunned for as long as the venom runs.
